technical-data.invention-title: ARMOIRE DE STOCKAGE POUR LINGE A LAVER

abstract.p: Clothes storing cabinet for washing consisting of storing cabinet body (1) for washing in which three chambers for clothes are created, the left chamber (2a), medium chamber (2b) and right chamber (2c), whereby the upper part of left chamber (2a) is equipped with left filling opening (6a), the upper part of medium chamber 2b) is equipped with medium filling opening (6b) and the upper part of left chamber (2c) is equipped with right filling opening (6c), whereby in lower part of left chamber (2a) is placed the left bottom closure (5a), in lower part of the medium chamber (2b) is placed the medium bottom closure (5b) and in lower part of right chamber (2c) is placed the right bottom closure (5c) and on front of left chamber (2a) capacity marks (10a) of the left chamber are marked, on front of medium chamber (2b) capacity marks (10b) of the medium chamber are marked and on front of right chamber (2c) capacity marks (10c) of the right chamber are marked and on body (1a) rear of the storing chamber for washing two upper grips (12a, 12b) and two lower grips (13a, 13b) are mounted, by means of which the clothes storing cabinet (1) for washing is movable fixed on right guide rod (3b) and left guide rod (3a), these are attached on wall (14) above drier (8) or washing machine (9) or alternatively the clothes storing cabinet (1) is swivelly fixed by means of swivelling bracket (4) on wall (14).

Armoire de stockage destinée au linge à laver, qui comprend un corps (1) renfermant trois compartiments pour le linge, un compartiment gauche (2a), un compartiment central (2b) et un compartiment droit (2c). La partie supérieure du compartiment gauche (2a) comporte un orifice de remplissage gauche (6a), la partie supérieure du compartiment central (2b) un orifice de remplissage central (6b) et la partie supérieure du compartiment droit (2c) un orifice de remplissage droit (6c). La partie inférieure du compartiment gauche (2a) comporte un dispositif de fermeture inférieur gauche (5a), la partie inférieure du compartiment central (2b) un dispositif de fermeture inférieur central (5b) et la partie inférieure du compartiment droit (2c) un dispositif de fermeture inférieur droit (5c). La partie avant du compartiment gauche (2a) comporte les repères de capacité (10a) du compartiment gauche, la partie avant du compartiment central (2b) les repères de capacité (10b) du compartiment central et la partie avant du compartiment droit (2c) les repères de capacité (10c) du compartiment droit. La partie du corps (1a) située à l'arrière du compartiment de stockage de linge à laver comporte deux éléments de fixation supérieurs (12a, 12b) et deux éléments de fixation inférieurs (13a, 13b), au moyen desquels l'armoire (1) est montée mobile sur une barre de guidage droite (3b) et sur une barre de guidage gauche (3a) fixées sur le mur (14) au-dessus du séchoir (8) ou du lave-linge (9). L'armoire (1) peut également être montée pivotante sur le mur (14) au moyen d'une patte de fixation pivotante (4).

description.p: CLOTHES STORING CABINET FOR WASHING
Technical sphere

The invention refers to construction of a storing cabinet for clothes prepared for washing and to its placing and to manipulation at storing, sorting and washing of used clothes, especially for storing and washing of small quantities.
Till now known state of the technique

For clothes storing before washing till now miscellaneous baskets, bags and chests are used, which have only one internal capacity and are placed on floor or are fastened on wall near to floor area. The disadvantage of such storing of clothes for washing is the impossibility of sorting and dosing before washing. Further disadvantage is that it requires considerable floor area in bathrooms, cloakrooms, passages or laundries and the manipulation with clothes stored in this way requires their transfer to washing equipment.
Substance of the invention

The substance of the invention is the constructional solution of the clothes storing cabinet for washing and its placing, which removes the above mentioned lacks. The substance of the clothes storing cabinet for washing is that it consists of the cabinet body for washing in which three chambers, the right, medium and left chamber for clothes are positioned, whereby each of these chambers has in upper part a filling opening and in lower part the chambers are fitted with bottom closure. On front of right, medium and left chamber for clothes three capacity marks, lower, medium and upper marks are located, limiting the batch of clothes for washing according to quantity and sort of clothes. Further on body rear of the cabinet for washing two upper and two lower grips are positioned, which are fixed in right and left guide rod, whereby the clothes storing cabinet for washing is movable positioned in area above drier or washing machine by means of right and left guide rod, which are fixed on wall behind the drier
or washing machine. An alternative gripping of the clothes storing cabinet for washing especially for cabinets with lower capacity is made by means of swivelling bracket attached on wall above the washing machine or drier and on this bracket is tilted fixed the clothes storing cabinet for washing. The clothes storing cabinet for washing according to this invention enables optimal storage and sorting of clothes before washing and lowers the physical effort at manipulation with clothes and removes objects from floors facilitating the maintenance of order and cleaness in objects.
Summary of figures on drawings

The invention is particularly elucidated by means of drawings, in Fig.1 is illustrated the front view of the clothes storing cabinet for washing and its positioning on wall above the drier close to washing machine. In Fig.2 is illustrated the lateral view of clothes storing cabinet for washing with vertical shifting above drier, in Fig. 3 is illustrated the lateral view of the clothes storing cabinet for washing with swivelling gripping on wall above drier and in Fig. 4 is illustrated the lateral view of the clothes storing cabinet for washing with swivelling gripping above drier in upper position. In Fig. 5 is illustrated the lateral view of the clothes storing cabinet for washing above drier in basic position.
Examples for realization of the invention
Example 1

The clothes storing cabinet for washing according to invention illustrated in Fig. 1 consists of body la of clothes storing cabinet for washing in which three chambers for clothes, the left chamber 2a, medium chamber 2b and right chamber 2c are made, whereby in upper part of the left chamber 2a the left filling opening 6a is made, in upper part of the medium chamber 2b the medium filling opening 6b_is made and in upper part of the right chamber 2c the right filling opening 6c is made. In lower part of the left chamber 2a the left bottom closure 5a is positioned, in lower part of the medium chamber 2b the medium bottom closure 5b is positioned and in lower part of the right
chamber 2c the right bottom closure is positioned, whereby on front of the left chamber 2a capacity marks jOa of the left chamber_are made, on front of the medium chamber 2b capacity marks K)b of the medium chamber are made and on front of the right chamber 2c capacity marks 10c of the right chamber are made. Further on body rear la of the cabinet for washing two upper grips 12a, 12b and two lower grips 13a,13b are located, which are fastened in right guide rod 3b and left guide rod 3a, whereby the cabinet for clothes for washing is movable positioned in area above drier 8 or washing machine 9^ whereby the guide rods 3a_and 3b are attached on wall above drier 8 or washing machine 9. The storing of clothes for washing consists in process that the clothes storing cabinet I for washing is in lower basic position A above drier 8 as it is illustrated in Fig. 5, in this position the separate chambers 2a, 2b, 2c of the clothes storing cabinet J_for washing are filled through upper filling openings 6a, 6b, 6c, whereby the clothes can be sorted into separate chambers. Information about capacity range indicate the capacity marks iOa, 10b, and Kjc. After filling the clothes storing cabinet l_for washing is shifted on guide rods 3a and 3b to upper working position B as it is illustrated in Fig. 4 and according to wants the stored and sorted clothes are spontaneous shifted from chambers 2a, 2b or 2c through bottom closures 5a. 5b or 5c of the chambers into basket 7 from which the clothes immediately are shifted into washing machine opening JT. After emptying of the clothes storing cabinet l_eventually its some chambers 2a, 2b or 2c the clothes storing cabinet j_ is shifted into basic position A and it is prepared for further filling or completing the cabinet with clothes.
Example 2

The clothes storing cabinet for washing according to invention in concrete example illustrated in Fig. 3 and 4, created as in example 1 is swinging positioned in area above drier 8 by means of swivelly bracket 4. The storing and sorting of clothes for washing is performed similarly as in example 1 at basic lower position A of the clothes storing cabinet 1 for washing through filling openings 6a, 6b and 6c, after filling up the chambers 2a, 2b and 2c with clothes the clothes storing cabinet \ for washing is swiveled through 90° into upper position B and emptied into basket 7 positioned on
drier 8 and from there the clothes are shifted into washing machine oprening 11.
Example 3

The clothes storing cabinet for washing according to invention created as in example 1 is placed in area above washing machine 9 by means of right 3a, and left 3b guide rods, which are attached on wall \A behind the washing machine 9.

The storing and sorting of clothings for washing is performed similarly as in example 1 in basic position of the clothes storing cabinet 1 for washing above washing machine, through filling openings 6a, 6b and 6c and after filling of chambers 2a, 2b and 2c with clothes the storing cabinet I is vertically shifted into upper position B and emptied through bottom closures 5a, 5b, 5c directly into washing machine opening JJ..
Example 4

The clothes storing cabinet for washing according to invention created as in example 1 is placed in area above washing machine 9 by means of swivelling bracket 4, wich is attached on wall behind the washing machine.

The storing and sorting of clothes is performed similarly as in example 1 in basic lower position of the clothes storing cabinet 1 for washing above washing machine 9 through filling openings 6a, 6b and 6c and after filling up the chambers 2a, 2b and 2c with clothes the clothes storing cabinet is swiveled through 90° into upper position B and emptied through bottom closures 5a. 5b, 5c directly into washing machine opening 1_L
Industrial utilizability

The clothes storing cabinet for washing is well applicable with advantageous manipulation with clothes at single piece work and also at series production everywhere where clothes are stored and washed in small amounts in different sorts.

2. Clothes storing cabinet for washing according to claim 1 characterised in that on body (la) rear of the storing cabinet for washing two upper grips (12a, 12b) and two lower grips (13a, 13b) are placed, by means of these the clothes storing cabinet (1) for washing is movable fixed on right guide rod (3b) and left guide rod (3a), these are attached on wall (14) above drier (8).

3. Clothes storing cabinet for washing according to claim 1 characterised in that on rear of the body (la) of cabinet for washing two upper grips (12a, 12b) and two lower grips (13a, 13b) are placed, by means of these the clothes storing cabinet (1) for washing is movable fixed on right guide rod (3b) and left guide rod, these are attached on wall (14) above washing machine (9).
4. Clothes storing cabinet for washing according to claim 1 characterised in that it is swivelly attached on wall (14) above drier (8) by means of swivelling bracket (4).
5. Clothes storing cabinet for washing according to claim 1 characterised in that it is swivelly fixed by means of swivelling bracket (4) on wall (14) above washing machine (9).
